flags.message: claude-baseline's reasoning and retrieval note report that its CourtListener lookup of docket 73374809 returned docket number 25-1301 with a Bernard/Ignelzi caption, whereas the provisioned event, petition and snapshot identify Kenneth Matsumura. Its captured log confirms a metadata lookup with retrieved date May 21, 2026, but provides a digest rather than the full result body. I did not independently re-fetch the metadata and do not assert that the discrepancy persists. Please verify the upstream docket-to-case mapping. All three evaluations follow the authoritative supplied Matsumura outcome, denial on October 5, 2026; the reported mismatch did not block scoring or establish leakage.
